hero.oneLiner: The deck positions Atal Realtech as a Nashik-based integrated civil works contractor and engineering firm working predominantly for Government of Maharashtra departments and authorities, whose Class I-A (unlimited capacity) registration underpins direct tendering, now extending into real estate development through a wholly owned subsidiary.

business_model.title: Positioning (investor deck)
business_model.body:
- "An integrated civil works contractor to the Government of Maharashtra" providing "integrated civil works contracting and engineering services, executing projects both directly as contractor to the awarding authority and, in certain cases, on a sub-contracting basis for main contractors."
- Registration credentials are framed as the gating moat: "Class I-A registration with unlimited work capacity with the Tribal Development Department, Public Works (Tribal) Division, and a Class IV registration with the Public Works Department — credentials that determine the size of tender we can bid for independently."
- "Beyond conventional item-rate contracting, we have the resources and manpower to deliver turnkey and design-build mandates — which pre-qualifies us for a class of tender many regional contractors cannot bid for."
- Clients are "predominantly departments, undertakings and development authorities of the Government of Maharashtra", named as Tribal Development Department, Public Works Department, MAHAGENCO, CIDCO, National Health Mission, MSPHC, plus one private residential developer (Parksyde Homes).
- Track record claim: "More than 20 projects successfully completed since inception across contracting and sub-contracting mandates. No project in the last three fiscals has been delayed, modified, cancelled or terminated in a manner that had a material adverse effect on the business."

capital_allocation.title: Capital allocation policy (investor deck)
capital_allocation.body:
- "Growth is funded, not free — Operating cash flow was negative ₹19.44 Cr in FY2026 (FY2025: negative ₹14.35 Cr), funded by ₹22.02 Cr of financing inflows. This is characteristic of a contractor scaling revenue against government certification and payment cycles — and is precisely what the proposed rights issue is intended to address."
- Balance sheet is described as lightly levered: debt to equity 0.14x in FY26, total borrowings ₹13.62 Cr in FY2026 (FY2025 ₹15.83 Cr; FY2024 ₹9.21 Cr) against net worth of ₹95.9 Cr, with contingent liabilities of ₹9.25 Cr.
- Return on net worth is modest and improving: 6.77% (FY2026), 5.26% (FY2025), 5.69% (FY2024); net asset value per share ₹7.74 (FY2026), ₹6.06 (FY2025), ₹5.10 (FY2024).
- Equity capital history of repeated primary issuance: bonus issue in 2:1 ratio in 2022 (98,68,000 shares of ₹10 each); maiden rights issue in 2024 of 3,70,05,000 shares at ₹7 (₹5 premium), after which "paid-up capital nearly doubles"; 45,00,000 convertible warrants issued at ₹16 each in 2025, of which 9,00,000 have been converted into equity.
- Paid-up capital rose from ₹1,480.20 lakhs (FY2024) to ₹2,220.30 lakhs (FY2025) to ₹2,477.93 lakhs (FY2026); authorised capital raised from ₹1,500.00 lakhs to ₹2,800.00 lakhs over the same period. The deck mentions no dividend.

other.title: Notable from the deck
other.body:
- [Corporate history] Incorporated in 2012 at Nashik as Atal Realtech Private Limited by Mr. Vijaygopal Atal; over 30 lakh sq. ft. of commercial and residential projects completed by 2019; converted to Atal Realtech Limited in 2020 alongside Class I-A registration with the Public Works (Tribal) Department; public limited since December 2019.
- [Governance] Promoter-led board: Mr. Vijaygopal Parasram Atal (Chairman & Managing Director, age 64, B.E. Civil, 30+ years) and Mr. Amit Sureshchandra Atal (Executive Director, age 42, also General Manager (Purchase)), with Ms. Tanvi Vijaygopal Atal as a non-executive non-independent director; three independent directors, one of whom (Mr. Omprakash Mohanlal Rungta) was appointed July 21, 2026. CFO Mr. Uday Satve has been with the Company since 2014.
- [Reporting basis caveat] The deck states annual information for Fiscals 2024-2026 is standalone audited under Ind AS while Q1 FY2027 is consolidated and unaudited, and that because Atal Realty Limited was established during Fiscal 2026 "annual and quarterly figures are not directly comparable in all respects."
- [Internal inconsistency] The client page states "28 projects currently under execution across Maharashtra" and "20+ projects completed since inception", while the snapshot, order book and portfolio pages state 28 contracts secured to date with 21 projects live at June 30, 2026 — both readings are reproduced as printed rather than reconciled.
- [Risk framing] The safe-harbour language names the operative risks as "project execution risk, client and government budgetary decisions, working capital availability, regulatory change and general economic conditions."
